name: Aoboshi One
summary: Single-weight serif-style Japanese font inspired by Copperplate Gothic, available on Google Fonts.
description: A single-weight serif-style Japanese typeface inspired by Copperplate Gothic, published on Google Fonts. The character set covers half-width alphanumerics, punctuation and Latin letters plus hiragana, katakana and full-width symbols. Sources, TTF builds and the license live in the matsuba723/Aoboshi repository.
contains: covers half-width alphanumerics, punctuation, Latin, hiragana, katakana and full-width symbols
